examples.title: Example 1: Setting a Touch Target via the responseRegion API
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set a touch target for a button using responseRegion to respond to click events.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting a Touch Target via the responseRegionList API
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set a touch target for a button using responseRegionList to respond to click events.
The responseRegionList API is supported since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Mouse Touch Target to Respond to Click Events
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the mouse touch target using mouseResponseRegion to respond to click events.
